blocks.text: HOUSTON — Kevin Durant scored 32 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each had 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers in the NBA on Monday night. Houston led by six points with about three minutes remaining before Durant made consecutive 3-pointers to make it 109-97.
